# Raktify

> Not-for-profit district-wide blood-response platform for India — connects hospitals with urgent blood requests, blood banks holding tested inventory, and voluntary donors in the surrounding district. Built and run by the Choudhari EduHealth India Foundation (Amravati).

Raktify's operational scope: donor registration and consent, blood-bank inventory + TTI screening, hospital-raised blood requests, matching engine that pairs requests with compatible bags and donors, WhatsApp-first notifications, DPDP-compliant data handling.

Technical stack (public): Node.js / Express backend on Azure App Service, React 18 + Vite frontend on Azure Static Web Apps, PostgreSQL 16 (Azure Flexible Server) with row-level security and audit-log triggers, WhatsApp Cloud API for notifications, Aadhaar eSign (Leegality) for institution MoU. Public REST webhook API is available for blood-bank software vendors to sync data.

## Vendor Integration API

- [Developer docs (HTML)](https://raktify.choudhari.ngo/developers): full documentation of the vendor push webhook — endpoints, authentication (HMAC-SHA256), request/response schemas, error codes, code examples in Node/Python/Java/C#, consent flow, rate limits
- [API reference (Markdown)](https://raktify.choudhari.ngo/developers.md): the same content as the HTML page in pure markdown — optimized for loading into LLM context. Give this URL to any AI coding assistant to have it write integration client code for you
- [OpenAPI 3.0 spec (YAML)](https://raktify.choudhari.ngo/api/vendor-webhook-v1.yaml): machine-readable, for openapi-generator / Insomnia / tooling
- [Postman collection](https://raktify.choudhari.ngo/api/vendor-webhook-v1.postman_collection.json): includes an HMAC-SHA256 pre-request script — import, set two variables, hit Send
